mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines relative to 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate weakening demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During low unemployment regimes (UNRATE < 3.5%), labor market tightness accelerates wage growth, increasing corporate costs and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals robust supply chain conditions, boosting corporate output and earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises above 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer spending (RSAFS) declines by more than 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months, weakening demand reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY), monetary policy tightening accelerates, increasing equity discount rates and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
